title: Frequently Asked Questions
description: Everything you need to know about TiktoMate: how it works, what is legal, how we protect your privacy and what to do when something goes wrong.
intro: Everything you need to know about TiktoMate: how it works, what is legal, how we protect your privacy and what to do when something goes wrong.

categories.name: General
categories.blurb: The basics: what TiktoMate is, what it costs and which devices you can use it on.

faqs.q: What is TiktoMate and what is it for?
faqs.a: TiktoMate is a free web tool that saves public TikTok videos, photos and audio in original quality, without the watermark. You paste a link and download the clean file the creator uploaded — no account, no app.

faqs.q: Is TiktoMate really free?
faqs.a: Yes. Every feature is free with no premium tier, no subscriptions and no artificial waits between downloads. An automatic anti-abuse check runs in the background that normal use never notices.

faqs.q: Is there a daily download limit?
faqs.a: There is no fixed daily quota for normal use. We only apply an automatic anti-abuse protection to keep the service reliable; everyday downloading is never affected.

faqs.q: Do I need to create an account or log in?
faqs.a: No. There are no accounts, no sign-up and no login. You paste a link and download, nothing more.

faqs.q: Does it work on every device and operating system?
faqs.a: Yes. TiktoMate works in any modern browser on iPhone, iPad, Android, Windows, Mac, Linux and Chromebook — nothing to install.

faqs.q: Why are there ads on TiktoMate?
faqs.a: Ads (when present) cover the cost of running the service so it can stay free. They never sit between you and your download, and there are no pop-ups or fake download buttons.

categories.name: Legality and copyright
categories.blurb: What you can and cannot do with the content you download, and how we respect creators.

faqs.q: Is it legal to download TikTok videos?
faqs.a: Saving public content for personal, offline use is broadly accepted in many places, but the video remains the creator's work. Reusing it commercially requires the creator's permission and must respect copyright law and TikTok's terms.

faqs.q: Can I repost other people's videos on my own accounts?
faqs.a: Only with the creator's permission, and with credit. Reposting someone's content as your own without consent can infringe copyright and TikTok's rules.

faqs.q: I am a creator and someone downloaded my video. What can I do?
faqs.a: If your content is being reused without permission, contact the platform where it appears and file a copyright/DMCA request. TiktoMate only handles public content and keeps no copies, so we can't remove files from others' devices.

faqs.q: Is TiktoMate affiliated with TikTok or ByteDance?
faqs.a: No. TiktoMate is an independent service and is not affiliated, sponsored by, or associated with TikTok or ByteDance Ltd.

faqs.q: Can I download videos from private accounts?
faqs.a: No. We only access what TikTok serves publicly without logging in. Private or restricted content is respected and cannot be downloaded.

categories.name: Privacy and security
categories.blurb: What data we touch, what we do not, and why you can use TiktoMate with peace of mind.

faqs.q: Does TiktoMate store my videos or the links I paste?
faqs.a: No. We store no videos, no history and no searches. The file goes straight from TikTok's servers to your device with nothing kept in between.

faqs.q: Do I need to install anything on my device?
faqs.a: No. TiktoMate is fully web-based — no app, no extension and no software to install.

faqs.q: Is TiktoMate safe to use?
faqs.a: Yes. There are no fake download buttons, no malware and no sign-up. You only download the media file you requested.

faqs.q: Which cookies does TiktoMate use?
faqs.a: Only essential technical storage to keep the service working and prevent abuse. We do not use advertising or tracking cookies.

faqs.q: Do you collect personal data from users?
faqs.a: We do not collect or sell personal data. Basic technical logs may be processed to prevent abuse and keep the service reliable.

categories.name: Common problems
categories.blurb: If something does not go as expected, the fix is most likely right here.

faqs.q: The link I paste does not work. What should I do?
faqs.a: Copy it from Share → Copy link in the app. Long tiktok.com links and short vm.tiktok.com / vt.tiktok.com links work; links re-shortened elsewhere or pointing to profiles/hashtags do not. The URL must point to a specific post.

faqs.q: The downloaded video has a logo or a mark on it. Why?
faqs.a: Some posts are only served by TikTok with the watermark layer. We deliver the cleanest version that actually exists and never fake a logo-free copy that TikTok doesn't provide.

faqs.q: On iPhone the video opens in the browser instead of downloading
faqs.a: Use Safari — on iOS it's the browser that handles downloads. If a tab opens instead, tap the share icon and choose Save Video, or long-press the video and pick Download. Check Settings → Safari → Downloads for where files land.

faqs.q: It says the video does not exist or was removed
faqs.a: The video was likely deleted, made private or restricted. If it won't open on TikTok without logging in, there's nothing public to download — TiktoMate keeps no copies.

faqs.q: How do I report a bug or suggest an improvement?
faqs.a: Reach out through the Contact page with the link that failed and a short description. We read every message and use it to improve the service.
